subject: Telugu AP
instruction:

Lessons to be studied in CBSE Class 11 Telugu AP.
expected_response:
Under CBSE Class 11 Telugu AP (107), Unit-I: Prose 
Lessons to be studied covers fundamental foundational principles aligned with NEP 2020 competency-based learning framework. Learners are evaluated on conceptual understanding, problem-solving application, and analytical rigor.
